ChatGPT tab tak shuru nahi ho sakta jab tak iska configuration theek nahi ho jata. Neeche di gayi samasya ke liye app ke configuration folder mein maujood config.toml ki jaanch karein, apne badlav save karein, phir "Dobara koshish karein" chunein. Agar aapko setting nahi mil rahi hai ya aapki organization ise manage karti hai, to apne IT administrator se sampark karein.{paragraphBreak}{detail}

desktop.workspacePolicyRecovery.detail: Jab tak aapki organization settings surakshit tareeke se load nahi ho jaati, app pause rahega. Ho sakta hai network connection, proxy, ya firewall access rok raha ho. Apna connection check karein aur dobara koshish karein, ya kisi aur account ko use karne ke liye sign out karein. Agar yeh samasya jaari rahe, to apne IT administrator se sampark karein

native.wslMigration.removeIncompatibleDe: Multi-folder projects aur legacy automations ko WSL remote connections par move nahi kiya ja sakta. Jaari rakhne par sirf neeche diye gaye saved projects aur automations hataye jayenge, aur phir aapke single-folder projects move kiye jayenge. Repository folders aur maujooda task history ko delete ya move nahi kiya jayega.

native.wslMigration.unavailableDetail: Jaanch lein ki aapke projects ke liye WSL distributions install hain, project folders Windows drive ya WSL paths ka istemaal karte hain, aur automation definitions padhi ja sakti hain. Koi bhi project ya automation hataya nahin gaya hai.
